VW-E6.Description:
Leads, payments and AI assistant

SCOPE:
- Supabase tables with RLS
- Free-scan + contact forms with email
- Checkout + webhook via payments interface
- Cal.com booking
- Grounded assistant
- Readiness check + lead qualifier

EFFORT: L (40 hours)
DEPENDENCIES: VW-E3; ADR-002 provider confirmed

EPIC LINK: epic/vfpscanner-web-implementation
FEATURE BRANCH: epic/VW-E6-leads-payments-ai

REFERENCE DOCS:
- SECURITY.md
- docs/PRICING.md
- docs/adr/ADR-002-merchant-of-record.md
- docs/adr/ADR-003-assistant-grounded-rag.md
- agents/AGENT.md

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- Lead lands in Supabase and email within 1 min
- Test purchase completes and records order once
- Assistant answers with citations and refuses off-scope

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Migrations for leads, orders, bookings, assistant_logs (see supabase/AGENT.md)
- RLS deny-all for anon; service role writes from server

EDGE CASES:
- Duplicate lead same email same day → update, not insert

EFFORT: S (2 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Data
DEPENDENCIES: None

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- RHF + Zod; server route /api/lead; Turnstile + honeypot + rate limit
- Resend: confirmation to visitor with download link; notification to owner with lead score
- GDPR consent checkbox stored with timestamp

EDGE CASES:
- Email provider down: lead still saved, retry later
- Disposable email domains
- Bot spam bursts
- Double submit

EFFORT: S (2 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: VW-030
